# oh-my-dsh
A seat-based multi-agent orchestration bundle for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**.
It ports the agent design of **oh-my-opencode-slim** — the "omo-slim" pantheon of specialised agents
— onto DSH's own seams: sessions, session projections, the tool runtime, and the subagent seam. Eve
rything ships inside this bundle; **no official package is modified**.
> **Derived from**: this project is an adaptation of **oh-my-opencode-slim** (by *Boring Dystopia De
velopment*, MIT licensed). The seat roster, personas, routing model and skill set are ported from th
at project; the DSH-side integration is original. See Credits & License.
English · 简体中文
# English
## What it is
oh-my-opencode-slim's idea is simple: instead of forcing one model to do everything, route each part
of the job to the agent best suited for it, balancing quality, speed and cost. This bundle implemen
ts that idea on DeepSeek Harness:
- **Eight specialised seats** — Orchestrator, Explorer, Fixer, Oracle, Designer, Council, Councillor
, Observer — each with a persona and a real tool policy (read-only seats physically cannot write or

spawn lanes).
- **A seat plane that lives beside DSH's official modes.** Seats are *not* agent prese
ts: they are defined in the bundle's own seat table, dispatched as isolated lanes by the `omo_dispat
ch` tool, or applied to a session by the seat runtime. The official preset picker keeps showing only

its own four modes.
- **Per-lane model routing** — each dispatch can name its own `provider`/`model
`; when it does not, the seat's configured default applies; with neither, the lane inherits the pare

nt session's *current* route.
- **A human-facing control surface** — the Agent chip in the composer
row switches the session's seat and carries a per-seat "dispatch default model" editor.
## Features
### The seat table
| Seat | Role | Tool policy |
| `orchestrator` | Plans, delegates, reconciles and verifies | full (fs, search, shell, delegation)

|
| `explorer` | Read-only codebase recon + external research | read-only (no write/edit/shell) |
|

`fixer` | Bounded implementation of well-specified changes | fs + search + shell |
| `oracle` | Arch

itecture, risk, debugging strategy, review | read-only |
| `designer` | UI/UX implementation and vis

ual polish | fs + search + shell |
| `council` | Multi-model consensus synthesis | **zero tools** (a

llow-list `[]`) |
| `councillor` | One independent, read-only council vote | read-only, no delegatio

n |
| `observer` | Visual analysis of images / PDFs / diagrams | read-only |
Tool policies are enforced at the **execution layer**, not just in the prompt: inherited tools are m
asked with `tools.restrict()`, and tools the session registered into its own scope are refused per c
all by a `tools.guard()` that reads the execution's tool name and re-checks the resolved definition.
A tool registered after the seat landed is refused too.
### Dispatch, not prompts
The Orchestrator delegates through the `omo_dispatch` tool: one call = one isolated lane with the se
at's persona, tool policy and model route. Independent lanes run in parallel, a lineage event record
s the relationship, and the parent receives the lane's final answer in a completion notice. The mult
i-model **Council** works the same way: councillor seats answer the same question on different model
s, then the zero-tool council seat synthesises the verdict.
## Requirements
- **DeepSeek Harness** desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer (CLI `0.2.0-rc.2` also works for the host side)

.
- The bundle declares these peers, resolved from the host: `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/ds
h-llm`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write`, `@de

epseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol`, `zod`.
- For per-lane model routing you need at least two registered

provider routes, and the profile must allow them for the session that dispatches.
- The **Model** e
ditor needs the bundle's client half (the Agent chip) to be mounted.
## Notes and limitations
- **Seats are not presets.** The official preset picker will never show them, and switching a seat d

oes not change the session's model — that stays with the official model selector.
- Switching to an

official mode from the picker lifts the omo layer for that session.
- The seat table is read from di
sk; user seats come from `<DSH_HOME>/omo/presets.json` and share the same `/preset` and chip surface

.
- The model editor only affects **future lane dispatches**; already-running lanes keep their model

.
- A council needs at least two distinct models in the profile; with fewer, it degrades to single-m

odel consensus.
- The bundle needs a restart to pick up a new `presets.json` (user seats), while sea
t model preferences apply from the next dispatch without a restart.

## 说明与限制

- **席位不是 preset。** 官方模式选择器里永远不会出现它们；切换席位也不改变会话模型——模型仍由官方模型选择器掌管。
- 从官方选择器切到官方模式时，该会话的 omo 层会被撤下。
- 席

位表从磁盘读取；用户席位来自 `<DSH_HOME>/omo/presets.json`，与出厂席位共用 `/preset` 和芯片入口。
- 模型编辑器只影响**之后的派发**；正在跑的 lane

保持原模型。
- 议会需要 profile 里至少两个不同模型；更少时会退化为单模型共识。
